", "context_files": [{"path": "pyproject.toml", "text": "[project]
name = "pymobiledevice3"
description = "Pure python3 implementation for working with iDevices (iPhone, etc...)"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.9"
license = "GPL-3.0-or-later"
keywords = [
    "ios",
    "protocol",
    "lockdownd",
    "instruments",
    "automation",
    "cli",
    "afc",
]
authors = [
    { name = "doronz88", email = "doron88@gmail.com" },
    { name = "matan", email = "matan1008@gmail.com" },
]
maintainers = [
    { name = "doronz88", email = "doron88@gmail.com" },
    { name = "matan", email = "matan1008@gmail.com" },
]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 5 - Production/Stable",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.9",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.14",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.15",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3 :: Only",
]
dynamic = ["version"]
dependencies = [
    "asn1",
    "IPython",
    "bpylist2>=4.0.1",
    "pygments",
    "daemonize",
    "pykdebugparser>=1.10.0",
    "pyusb>=1.2.1",
    "rich>=13.0.0",
    "ansilogs>=1.1.0",
    "requests",
    "packaging",
    "typing_extensions>=4.1.0",
    "pygnuutils>=0.0.7",
    "cryptography>=43.0.0",
    "pycrashreport>=2.0.0",
    "fastapi>=0.93.0",
    "uvicorn>=0.15.0",
    "wsproto",
    "Pillow",
    "questionary>=2.0.0",
    "ipsw_parser>=1.9.0",
    "ifaddr",
    "hyperframe",
    "qh3>=1.0.0,<2",
    "developer_disk_image>=0.3.0",
    "opack2>=0.2.0",
    "psutil",
    "pytun-pmd3>=3.0.3",
    "prompt_toolkit",
    "sslpsk-pmd3>=1.0.3; python_version < '3.13'",
    "python-pcapng>=2.1.1",
    "pyimg4>=0.8.8",
    "pyiosbackup>=0.2.4",
    "typer>=0.23.2,<0.24.0; python_version < '3.10'",
    "typer>=0.25; python_version >= '3.10'",
    "typer-injector>=0.3.0",
    "defusedxml",
    "pywin32; platform_system == 'Windows'",
    # Declarative binary records and codecs for the wire formats (usbmux, AFC, DTX, XPC, pcapd, ...);
    # formerly the in-tree pymobiledevice3/binary.py. Its errors are bytestruct's (import them from bytestruct).
    "bytestruct>=0.1.0",
    # IORegistry access for `doctor`: tells "the host does not see this device at all" apart from
    # "usbmuxd is not listing it", which are the same symptom with different fixes. IOKit is macOS.
    # 0.0.6 floor: the first release shipping py.typed, without which every property read here is
    # Unknown to pyright and needs a cast plus a suppression to stay clean.
    "ioregistry>=0.0.6; platform_system == 'Darwin'",
    "av>=14.0.0; platform_system != 'Darwin'",
    # pmd-pytcp — the no-root userspace tunnel's TCP/IP stack, a minimal PyTCP fork
    # (https://github.com/doronz88/pmd-pytcp). Pulls its pmd-net-addr / pmd-net-proto siblings in
    # transitively. Supported on Python 3.9+ (the whole pymobiledevice3 range); if the import or
    # stack init fails the tunnel transparently falls back to the kernel path (see cli_common).
    # 0.3.7 floor: the complete 2026-08 stability-audit series. The API contract strictly
    # needs only 0.3.4 — session death (RST / FIN / reaper / 2MSL) wakes blocked recv()
    # waiters, which the relay handler in userspace_tunnel.py relies on to finish promptly
    # once it fully closes an abandoned connection's pytcp socket, plus the NUD FAILED
    # black-hole fix (a device asleep ~3 s could kill the tunnel until process restart) —
    # but 0.3.5-0.3.7 carry the rest of the audit's liveness/bounds work (datapath loops
    # survive their first exception instead of dying silently, per-session timer spins
    # stopped, connect() failures always surface, every queue/table bounded), and the floor
    # guarantees no pymobiledevice3 install runs a stack with those known wedge modes.
    # 0.3.8 makes the delayed-ACK timer one-shot: it re-armed itself forever, waking every
    # tunnel connection every ACK_DELAY_MS (1000/s at our 1 ms) even when idle (#2038).
    # 0.3.0 added the 'net.rx_cksum_validate' software RX-checksum-offload sysctl
    # (skips the RFC 1071 checksum on the AEAD-authenticated tunnel; ~+35% bulk download).
    # 0.2.0 added dynamic send-MSS via working RFC 4821/8899 PLPMTUD (probing sysctls
    # tcp.mtu_probing / tcp.base_mss / tcp.plpmtud.probe_timer_ms, the tcp.rto.min_ms floor,
    # and the runtime 'log.enabled' hot-path gate). userspace_tunnel.py sets these knobs
    # unconditionally — no capability probing — so the floor IS the compatibility contract.
    # (0.1.0 introduced the pure-asyncio stack the module is written against.)
    "pmd-pytcp>=0.3.8; python_version >= '3.9'",
    # pmd-pytcp's address types, which userspace_tunnel.py imports directly. pmd-pytcp pins the
    # version it was built against.
    "pmd-net-addr",
    # WebDAV mounting of AFC services (`<group> webdav`). ASGIWebDAV requires Python >= 3.10, so it
    # is gated accordingly; the CLI surfaces a clear message on 3.9. backports.zstd supplies the zstd
    # module ASGIWebDAV imports on 3.10-3.13 (stdlib on 3.14+); uvicorn is already a dependency above.
    "asgiwebdav>=2.0.1; python_version >= '3.10'",
    "backports.zstd; python_version >= '3.10' and python_version < '3.14'",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
test = ["pytest", "pytest-asyncio", "httpx"]
# Docs tooling targets Python >= 3.10 (mkdocs-llmstxt / recent mkdocstrings); markers keep the
# project's 3.9 floor resolvable since uv resolves all extras universally.
docs = [
    "mkdocs-material>=9.5; python_version >= '3.10'",
    "mkdocstrings[python]>=0.26; python_version >= '3.10'",
    "mkdocs-llmstxt>=0.5; python_version >= '3.10'",
]
full = ["pymobiledevice3[test,docs]"]

[project.urls]
"Homepage" = "https://github.com/doronz88/pymobiledevice3"
"Bug Reports" = "https://github.com/doronz88/pymobiledevice3/issues"

[project.scripts]
pymobiledevice3 = "pymobiledevice3.__main__:main"

[tool.setuptools]
package-data = { "pymobiledevice3" = [
    "py.typed",
    "resources/webinspector/*.js",
    "resources/webinspector/logo.png",
    "resources/dsc_uuid_map.json",
    "resources/notifications.txt",
    "resources/serve_web/viewer.html",
    "resources/serve_web/viewer.css",
    "resources/serve_web/viewer.js",
] }

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
exclude = ["docs*", "tests*"]

[tool.setuptools.dynamic]
version = { attr = "pymobiledevice3._version.__version__" }

[tool.setuptools_scm]
version_file = "pymobiledevice3/_version.py"

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=43.0.0", "setuptools_scm>=8", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[tool.pyright]
include = ["pymobiledevice3", "tests"]
pythonVersion = "3.9"
typeCheckingMode = "standard"
# Bug-revealing strict-mode rules adopted incrementally on top of standard.
reportUnnecessaryComparison = "error"
reportUnnecessaryIsInstance = "error"
reportUnnecessaryCast = "error"
reportUntypedNamedTuple = "error"
reportDeprecated = "error"
reportMissingTypeArgument = "error"
reportMissingParameterType = "error"
reportUnknownVariableType = "error"
reportUnknownMemberType = "error"
reportUnknownArgumentType = "error"
reportUnknownParameterType = "error"
reportUnknownLambdaType = "error"
venvPath = "."
venv = ".venv"

# The reportMissingParameterType and reportUnknown* rules are enforced across the package, but not
# on the test suite: test fixtures, monkeypatch callbacks and mock stubs are deliberately
# loosely-typed and annotating/narrowing them adds noise without catching real bugs.
[[tool.pyright.executionEnvironments]]
root = "tests"
extraPaths = ["."]
reportMissingParameterType = "none"
reportUnknownVariableType = "none"
reportUnknownMemberType = "none"
reportUnknownArgumentType = "none"
reportUnknownParameterType = "none"
reportUnknownLambdaType = "none"

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py39"
line-length = 120
fix = true
